product.title: JetCar Fort Lauderdale Rental

description.text: Drive a unique JetCar on the waterways of Fort Lauderdale during this guided rental experience. Cruise scenic channels with pre-departure orientation and safety instruction, and enjoy a fun water activity close to downtown and coastal neighborhoods.

highlights: Pilot a JetCar watercraft on Fort Lauderdale waterways
Capture social-ready photos during the ride
Great option for visitors seeking a unique water activity

start.description: Meet at the Fort Lauderdale marina departure point. Check-in instructions and exact meeting details are provided after booking.

itineraryItems.title: Arrival and check-in
itineraryItems.description: Meet staff and complete waiver and safety orientation.

itineraryItems.title: JetCar on-water session
itineraryItems.description: Enjoy your timed JetCar rental route with guidance from staff.

itineraryItems.title: Return and wrap-up
itineraryItems.description: Dock at the marina and receive post-ride assistance.

additionalInfo: Arrive early for check-in and onboarding

faqs.question: Do I need prior JetCar experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is required. Staff provide a safety and controls orientation before departure.

faqs.question: How long is the rental?
faqs.answer: The on-water experience is approximately 1 hour.

faqs.question: Is safety gear included?
faqs.answer: Yes, life jackets and required safety equipment are included.
